violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Raw beef in the cold service line was temping at 49F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL COLD FOODS SHOULD BE HELD AT A TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW. RAW BEEF HAD ONLY BEEN PLACED IN COOKER AROUND 9AM SO PIC MOVED RAW BEEF TO THE 3DR UCR BEHIND CASH TO COOL BACK TO 41F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed mouthwash, collagen pills, Advil and other vitamins being stored in food prep and food storage areas at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL PERSONAL CARE ITEMS MUST BE STORED IN ITS OWN DESIGNATED LOCATION OUT OF FOOD PREP AND FOOD STORAGE AREAS. PIC MOVED THE PERSONAL CARE ITEMS OUT OF FOOD AREAS.
